deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout v2026-03-21b -> prod. Plan: 0% -> 5% -> 25% -> 50% every 10m. Current step: 5%. watching health metrics now. // rollout_id: r-8943

sara-ops: copying ops here. I'll be on standby for stop/go. any specific regions to watch? :eyes:

lina: seeing a spike of 502s in ap-south-1 on the images route (/v1/generate-image). Not seeing same in eu-west/us-west. small but reproducible. recommend hold at 5% and investigate.

kmurphy: how bad are the 502s? user-facing? rates?

lina: about 0.8% error rate on ap-south, request-level errors only for streaming false (non-stream). Avg latency up 200ms for that route. Sample logs:
```
2026-03-21T14:12:03Z worker-23 kvcache: eviction failed: OOM
2026-03-21T14:12:03Z worker-23 inference: respond 502 path=/v1/generate-image model=v2026-03-21b
```

sara-ops: ok holding. @deploy-bot pause rollout now and pin traffic at current 5%.

deploy-bot: Manual pause issued by sara-ops. Rollout paused at 5%. Reason: elevated 502s in ap-south-1. Snapshotting metrics and saving trace. grafana: https://grafana.redwood.prod/d/rollouts/r-8943

reza: thanks. @lina do you think it's a model memory pressure (kvcache) or infra change? any quick mitigation?

lina: seems like kvcache warm / memory pressure on some older Ampere nodes. Quick mitigation options: 1) pin traffic away from ap-south nodes, 2) pin model back to v2026-03-19c (previous release), or 3) temporary routing policy to avoid non-streaming image requests in ap-south. My vote: pin to previous release while we triage.

kmurphy: +1 for pin. We should avoid broad rollback if only one region affected. Can we do a model variant pin for ap-south only?

lina: yes, routing supports per-region model pins. Sample command (infra):
```bash
redwoodctl rollout pin --region ap-south-1 --model v2026-03-19c --rollout r-8943 --reason "ap-south 502s"
```

sara-ops: do it. @kmurphy monitor global error rate and let me know if any other region spikes. If ap-south continues >0.5% 502 after pin for 10m, we'll rollback globally.

deploy-bot: Executing command: `redwoodctl rollout pin --region ap-south-1 --model v2026-03-19c --rollout r-8943` ... done. Routing updated; pinned region to v2026-03-19c. Note: traffic remains at 5% overall.

reza: I opened a quick CR describing the pin and follow-up triage: https://cr.redwood/reviews/3281. Assigned to @lina for kvcache profiling.

kmurphy: monitoring now. Current global 5xx rate = 0.12% (pre-pause baseline 0.05%). ap-south 5xx = 0.85% -> after pin 0.06% (steadying). Looks like pin worked. :thumbsup:

sara-ops: excellent. keep the rollout paused for one full warmup cycle (20m) and then reconvene for go/no-go. If anything creeps, we abort and rollback.

lina: will run memprofs on the affected hosts and send logs to the incident channel. I suspect a particular kernel memory alloc path that regresses under certain image models.

reza: ack. I'll prep release notes update and call out the regional pin in the changelog section.

sara-ops: decision: hold rollout at 5% for 20m while triage continues. If no other regressions, we'll resume to 25% in a controlled wave excluding ap-south until a fix is rolled. Everyone react with :white_check_mark: once you see stable metrics.

kmurphy: :white_check_mark:

lina: :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Rollout r-8943 remains paused at 5% (pinned ap-south to v2026-03-19c). Action items: 1) Lina to triage kvcache (in progress), 2) Reza to update release notes/CR, 3) Ops to monitor. Next check-in in 20m.

sara-ops: thanks all. If anyone sees new regressions tag me and we'll escalate.
